chapterInfo.content:
28
Isak hyira Yakob, na ɔgya no kwan kɔ Mesopotamia
1 # Gye 24.3 Na Isak frɛɛ Yakob, na ɔhyiraa no hyɛɛ no sɛ: Nware ɛyerɛ wɔ Kanaan mmammaa mu. 2#Gye 22.23; 24.29 Sɔre kɔ Mesopotamia kɔ wo na n’agya Betuel fie, na kɔware wɔ wo na nua Laban mmammaa mu bi. 3Na Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn nhyira wo, na ɔmma wo nnɔ, na ɔmma wo nyɛ bebree, na woayɛ aman asafo; 4#Gye 12.2 na ɔmfa Abraham nhyira nhyira wo, wo ne w’asefoɔ a wɔka wo ho, na woanya asase a woyɛ so hɔhoɔ a Onyankopɔn de ama Abraham yi. 5Na Isak gyaa Yakob kwan, na ɔkɔɔ Mesopotamia wɔ Aramni Betuel ba Laban a ɔyɛ Yakob ne Esau wɔn na Rebeka nuabarima no nkyɛn.
Esau ware ɔbaa foforɔ
6Na Esau hunuu sɛ Isak ahyira Yakob, ama wagya no kwan sɛ ɔnkɔ Mesopotamia nkɔware yerɛ wɔ hɔ. Afei ɔhunuu bio sɛ ɔhyiraa no hyɛɛ no sɛ: Nware Kanaan mmammaa mu yerɛ, 7na Yakob tiee n’agya ne ne na, na ɔkɔɔ Mesopotamia. 8Na Esau hunuu sɛ Kanaan mmammaa nyɛ wɔ n’agya Isak ani soɔ no, 9#Gye 25.13; 26.34 ɔsii mu kɔɔ Ismael nkyɛn kɔwaree Abraham ba Ismael babaa, Nebaiot nuabaa Mahalat kaa ne yerenom no ho.
Yakob daeɛso wɔ Betel
10Na Yakob firi Beer-seba sii mu kɔɔ Haran. 11Na ɔduruu baabi no ɔsoɛɛ hɔ anadwo no, ɛfiri sɛ na owia akɔtɔ. Na ɔfaa hɔ aboɔ no bi de yɛɛ sumiiɛ, na ɔdaa hɔ. 12#Yoh 1.51 Na ɔsoo daeɛ, na hwɛ, na atwedeɛ bi si fam a atifi pem soro, na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ redi so aforosiane. 13#Gye 12.7 Na hwɛ, AWURADE gyina atifi, na ɔse: Mene AWURADE, w’agya Abraham Nyankopɔn ne Isak Nyankopɔn; asase a woda soɔ yi mede bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ. 14#Gye 13.16; 12.3 Na w’asefoɔ bɛyɛ sɛ asase so mfuturo, na woatrɛ akɔ atɔeɛ ne apueeɛ, atifi fam ne anafoɔ fam. Na wo ne w’asefoɔ mu na wɔbɛhyira wiase mmusuakuo nyinaa. 15Na hwɛ, mɛdi w’akyi, na mahwɛ wo so baabiara a wobɛkorɔ, na mama woasane aba asase yi so. Na merennya wo de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ mɛma deɛ maka makyerɛ woɔ yi aba mu. 16Na Yakob nyane firii ne nna mu no, ɔkaa sɛ: Ampa ara, AWURADE wɔ ha yi, nanso me deɛ, manhunu. 17#Eks 3.5 Na ɔsuroe, na ɔse: Ɛha yi yɛ hu ampa. Ɛha nyɛ baabiara sɛ Nyankopɔn fie, na ɛha ne ɔsoro aboboano.
18Na Yakob sɔree anɔpatutu, na ɔfaa ɔboɔ a ɔde yɛɛ sumiiɛ no de yɛɛ odum sii hɔ, na ɔhwiee ngo guu so. 19#Gye 35.14-15 Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ: Betel,#28.19 BETEL: Asekyerɛ ne: Nyankopɔn fie. nanso akane no na kuro no din de Lus.
20Na Yakob hyɛɛ bɔ kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn bɛdi m’akyi ahwɛ me so ɔkwan a merebɛtuo yi mu, na wama me aduane madi ne atadeɛ mahyɛ, 21na wasane me asomdwoeɛ mu de me aba m’agya fie a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛyɛ me Nyankopɔn. 22#Gye 35.1, 7 Na ɔboɔ yi a mede mayɛ odum asi hɔ yi bɛyɛ Nyankopɔn fie. Na deɛ wobɛma me nyinaa, mɛma wo so ntotosoɔ du du.

Na Isak frɛɛ Yakob, na ɔhyiraa no hyɛɛ no sɛ: Nware ɛyerɛ wɔ Kanaan mmammaa mu. Sɔre kɔ Mesopotamia kɔ wo na n’agya Betuel fie, na kɔware wɔ wo na nua Laban mmammaa mu bi. Na Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn nhyira wo, na ɔmma wo nnɔ, na ɔmma wo nyɛ bebree, na woayɛ aman asafo; na ɔmfa Abraham nhyira nhyira wo, wo ne w’asefoɔ a wɔka wo ho, na woanya asase a woyɛ so hɔhoɔ a Onyankopɔn de ama Abraham yi. Na Isak gyaa Yakob kwan, na ɔkɔɔ Mesopotamia wɔ Aramni Betuel ba Laban a ɔyɛ Yakob ne Esau wɔn na Rebeka nuabarima no nkyɛn.

Na Esau hunuu sɛ Isak ahyira Yakob, ama wagya no kwan sɛ ɔnkɔ Mesopotamia nkɔware yerɛ wɔ hɔ. Afei ɔhunuu bio sɛ ɔhyiraa no hyɛɛ no sɛ: Nware Kanaan mmammaa mu yerɛ, na Yakob tiee n’agya ne ne na, na ɔkɔɔ Mesopotamia. Na Esau hunuu sɛ Kanaan mmammaa nyɛ wɔ n’agya Isak ani soɔ no, ɔsii mu kɔɔ Ismael nkyɛn kɔwaree Abraham ba Ismael babaa, Nebaiot nuabaa Mahalat kaa ne yerenom no ho.

Na Yakob firi Beer-seba sii mu kɔɔ Haran. Na ɔduruu baabi no ɔsoɛɛ hɔ anadwo no, ɛfiri sɛ na owia akɔtɔ. Na ɔfaa hɔ aboɔ no bi de yɛɛ sumiiɛ, na ɔdaa hɔ. Na ɔsoo daeɛ, na hwɛ, na atwedeɛ bi si fam a atifi pem soro, na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ redi so aforosiane. Na hwɛ, AWURADE gyina atifi, na ɔse: Mene AWURADE, w’agya Abraham Nyankopɔn ne Isak Nyankopɔn; asase a woda soɔ yi mede bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ. Na w’asefoɔ bɛyɛ sɛ asase so mfuturo, na woatrɛ akɔ atɔeɛ ne apueeɛ, atifi fam ne anafoɔ fam. Na wo ne w’asefoɔ mu na wɔbɛhyira wiase mmusuakuo nyinaa. Na hwɛ, mɛdi w’akyi, na mahwɛ wo so baabiara a wobɛkorɔ, na mama woasane aba asase yi so. Na merennya wo de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ mɛma deɛ maka makyerɛ woɔ yi aba mu. Na Yakob nyane firii ne nna mu no, ɔkaa sɛ: Ampa ara, AWURADE wɔ ha yi, nanso me deɛ, manhunu. Na ɔsuroe, na ɔse: Ɛha yi yɛ hu ampa. Ɛha nyɛ baabiara sɛ Nyankopɔn fie, na ɛha ne ɔsoro aboboano.
Na Yakob sɔree anɔpatutu, na ɔfaa ɔboɔ a ɔde yɛɛ sumiiɛ no de yɛɛ odum sii hɔ, na ɔhwiee ngo guu so. Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ: Betel, nanso akane no na kuro no din de Lus.
Na Yakob hyɛɛ bɔ kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn bɛdi m’akyi ahwɛ me so ɔkwan a merebɛtuo yi mu, na wama me aduane madi ne atadeɛ mahyɛ, na wasane me asomdwoeɛ mu de me aba m’agya fie a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛyɛ me Nyankopɔn. Na ɔboɔ yi a mede mayɛ odum asi hɔ yi bɛyɛ Nyankopɔn fie. Na deɛ wobɛma me nyinaa, mɛma wo so ntotosoɔ du du.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
